description.p1: {link}提供对所有规划数据、游戏内元数据（建筑、配方、物资）以及 VWAP 等计算市场指标的程序化访问。公共端点仍可供社区使用，但访问私人规划数据（包括你的规划配置）则需要安全认证。
description.p2: 通过使用这些端点，你可以将规划操作与外部电子表格、自定义仪表板，甚至优化算法同步。
description.warning: Every API key reads all your planning data, and a read & write key can also change and delete it. Keys stay valid until you revoke them, change your password or your account is deactivated. Treat them like your password: never commit keys to public repositories or share them with unverified third-party services. If a key is compromised, revoke it immediately and generate a replacement.
description.warning_sheets: A key in a Google Sheets URL is visible to everyone who can open the sheet, and a key in a URL can only read. Use a separate read-only key per sheet so you can revoke it alone.

get_started.step_create: 在下面创建一把密钥，并存到安全的地方。

get_started.step_paste: 复制 Google Sheets 公式、URL，或 curl / Python 片段，粘贴到你的表格或脚本里。
